Availability.description: Maintenance window. Leave maintenance_enabled false until you need to block the app.

maintenance_enabled.description: Blocks the whole app with the maintenance screen while the window is open.

defaultValue.value: Credvert is temporarily unavailable while we make improvements. Cards saved on this device stay here.

maintenance_starts_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC start, for example 2026-10-01T18:30:00Z. Empty means start now.

maintenance_ends_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC end. Empty means stay on until you turn maintenance off. Must be after the start.

maintenance_show_retry.description: Shows a Try again button that fetches Remote Config again.

Versioning.description: Force update blocks the app. Soft update is a dismissible sheet. Set store links before enabling either one.

force_update_enabled.description: When true, builds below the minimum version or build are blocked.

min_supported_version.description: Oldest version name still allowed. Use major.minor.patch only, for example 1.2.0.

min_supported_build.description: Oldest version code still allowed. 0 disables this check. The current app build is 1.

soft_update_enabled.description: When true, older builds see a dismissible update sheet. Ignored when a force update applies.

latest_build.description: Newest version code. 0 disables the build comparison for the soft prompt.

update_title.description: Soft update sheet title. Max 80 characters.

defaultValue.value: Update Credvert for the latest fixes and improvements. You can keep using this version for now.

update_message.description: Soft update sheet body. Max 600 characters.

force_update_title.description: Blocking update screen title. Max 80 characters.

defaultValue.value: This version of Credvert is no longer supported. Update to keep your wallet and recommendations working.

force_update_message.description: Blocking update screen body. Max 600 characters.

android_store_url.description: https Play Store link. javascript: and other schemes are ignored.

ios_store_url.description: https App Store link, for example https://apps.apple.com/app/id1234567890. Required before a force update on iPhone.

Announcement.description: One in-app announcement. Change announcement_id whenever the message changes so people who dismissed the old one see the new one.

announcement_enabled.description: Shows the announcement while its window is open.

announcement_id.description: Required when enabled. 1-64 letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores. Example: diwali-2026.

announcement_title.description: Max 80 characters. Required together with a message, or the announcement stays hidden.

announcement_severity.description: info, success, warning, or critical. critical plus dismissible false blocks the app.

announcement_dismissible.description: False on a critical announcement blocks the app until you change the config.

announcement_action_label.description: Button label. Max 32 characters. Both label and URL are required or the button is hidden.

announcement_action_url.description: https link opened by the button.

announcement_starts_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC start. Empty means start now.

announcement_ends_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC end. Empty means no end. Must be after the start.

Whats new.description: Shown once per whats_new_version, after any soft-update sheet is dismissed.

whats_new_version.description: Id for this release note, for example 1.2.0. Changing it shows the sheet again.

whats_new_body.description: One bullet per line. The app keeps the first 8 lines, 140 characters each.

Features.description: Turn product areas off without shipping a new build. Defaults leave everything on.

feature_guest_mode_enabled.description: Hides Continue without an account. People already in guest mode stay signed in on this device.

feature_push_enabled.description: Shows the Notifications row in Account. Does not send a prompt on launch.

Links.description: Used when the Credvert API does not return a legal URL, and for support from the maintenance and update screens.

support_email.description: Plain email address, for example hello@credvert.app. The app opens a mail draft.

help_url.description: https help center URL. Shows a Help center row when set.

config_schema_version.description: Leave at 1. The app ignores unknown future keys and still applies every key it knows.
